title: VentureForge 2026: Inter-Collegiate Seed Grant
description: Non-dilutive grant funding awarded to hardware prototypes solving physical world challenges in climate, accessibility, or robotics. Includes dedicated makerspace bay access.
eligibility: Must have at least two collegiate co-founders enrolled in participating alliance universities.

title: Atmospheric Hardware Fellowship: Fall Cohort
description: 3-month residency supporting researchers developing sub-orbital balloons, micro-aerial drones, and autonomous telemetry probes.
eligibility: Open to undergraduate, master's, or doctoral candidates.

title: Frontier AI Safety & Agent Reasoning Grant
description: Targeted research funding for multi-agent coordination proofs, sandboxed execution bounds, and verifiable tool invocation architectures.
eligibility: Student researchers submitting reproducible open-source implementations.

title: NextGen Clean Energy Micro-Grid Challenge
description: Global collegiate innovation competition for decentralized energy storage, sodium battery battery management systems, and rural microgrids.
eligibility: Multidisciplinary student teams across any recognized university.
perks: Pilot deployment in Himachal rural microgrid
